notes: REF-BM-03: title editable before/after and description editable before save, but normal Edit dialog hides the description field (direct=!duplicate → hidden), so auto-collected description is not editable after saving except via re-paste duplicate path. REF-BM-04: title/tags/notes editable, but url cannot be edited (PATCH ignores url, no url field) and description edit is hidden in normal edit. REF-BM-11: single-tag filtering only reachable by typing tag: in search; card tag chips are non-clickable spans, no tag-select affordance. REF-BM-14: tag search implemented as tag: syntax, not the required #tag syntax (# treated as plain text). REF-BM-20: no multi-select UI or bulk-action endpoints exist. REF-BM-21: no bulk-to-filter-scope action. REF-BM-22: no sort control or sort param; list only fixed newest-first via unshift. REF-BM-23: markdown note can be written/stored but is never rendered in any view and no markdown parsing exists. REF-BM-24: 'saved copy' stores extracted metadata+paragraphs as JSON reader view, not a single-file HTML snapshot, and PDFs are rejected (content-type must be text/html) so the PDF rule is unmet. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26: no archived flag/state on bookmarks. REF-BM-27: no archive concept, so archive-vs-delete distinction absent. REF-BM-28: no archived-bookmarks list (only Library/Read later). REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: no user display settings (default sort/items/font size).
